# NEW 2026-11-21 v7.1 Stage 2 Package 4, Poland-Lithuania Regional Line (1360-1580, oe_plc_). Generated by gen_poland_lithuania.py; edit the generator, not this file.


# Initialize Poland-Lithuania regional line global state (idempotent).
oe_plc_init = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_plc_init } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_plc_init value = 1 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_plc_on value = 1 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_plc_stage value = 0 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_plc_union_path value = 0 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_plc_grunwald_state value = 0 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_plc_ruthenia_stance value = 0 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_plc_lublin_state value = 0 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_plc_ev_cnt value = 0 }
    }
}

# Fire event $ev$ to the best target among PLC / POL / LIT / TEU (prefers human player).
oe_plc_dispatch = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:PLC c:PLC = { is_ai = no } }
        c:PLC = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_plc.$ev$ }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:POL c:POL = { is_ai = no } }
        c:POL = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_plc.$ev$ }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:LIT c:LIT = { is_ai = no } }
        c:LIT = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_plc.$ev$ }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:TEU c:TEU = { is_ai = no } }
        c:TEU = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_plc.$ev$ }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:PLC }
        c:PLC = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_plc.$ev$ }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:POL }
        c:POL = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_plc.$ev$ }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:LIT }
        c:LIT = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_plc.$ev$ }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:TEU }
        c:TEU = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_plc.$ev$ }
    }
    change_global_variable = { name = oe_plc_ev_cnt add = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_plc_ev_m value = oe_plc_m_now }
}

# Monthly tick (scheduler slot 49, also called by oe_plc_fallback_pulse if BYZ is gone).
# Takes NO BYZ main-line lock; idempotent per calendar month via oe_plc_ran_m.
oe_plc_monthly = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { global_var:oe_plc_ran_m ?= oe_plc_m_now } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_plc_ran_m value = oe_plc_m_now }
        oe_plc_init = yes
        if = {
            limit = { has_global_variable = oe_plc_on oe_plc_any_alive = yes }
            # Same-month spacing: at most one oe_plc event per calendar month.
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { global_var:oe_plc_ev_m ?= oe_plc_m_now } }
                if = {
                    limit = { current_year >= 1362 NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_plc_ev_1 } }
                    set_global_variable = { name = oe_plc_ev_1 value = 1 }
                    oe_plc_dispatch = { ev = 1 }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { current_year >= 1385 NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_plc_ev_2 } }
                    set_global_variable = { name = oe_plc_ev_2 value = 1 }
                    oe_plc_dispatch = { ev = 2 }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { current_year >= 1409 NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_plc_ev_3 } }
                    set_global_variable = { name = oe_plc_ev_3 value = 1 }
                    oe_plc_dispatch = { ev = 3 }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { current_year >= 1410 has_global_variable = oe_plc_ev_3 NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_plc_ev_4 } }
                    set_global_variable = { name = oe_plc_ev_4 value = 1 }
                    oe_plc_dispatch = { ev = 4 }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { current_year >= 1413 NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_plc_ev_5 } }
                    set_global_variable = { name = oe_plc_ev_5 value = 1 }
                    oe_plc_dispatch = { ev = 5 }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { current_year >= 1444 NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_plc_ev_6 } }
                    set_global_variable = { name = oe_plc_ev_6 value = 1 }
                    oe_plc_dispatch = { ev = 6 }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { current_year >= 1466 NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_plc_ev_7 } }
                    set_global_variable = { name = oe_plc_ev_7 value = 1 }
                    oe_plc_dispatch = { ev = 7 }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { current_year >= 1505 NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_plc_ev_8 } }
                    set_global_variable = { name = oe_plc_ev_8 value = 1 }
                    oe_plc_dispatch = { ev = 8 }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { current_year >= 1569 NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_plc_ev_9 } }
                    set_global_variable = { name = oe_plc_ev_9 value = 1 }
                    oe_plc_dispatch = { ev = 9 }
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = { current_year >= 1580 has_global_variable = oe_plc_ev_9 }
                remove_global_variable = oe_plc_on
            }
        }
    }
}

    oe_plc_test_clear = yes
    oe_plc_init = yes
}

oe_plc_test_month = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_plc_init } } oe_plc_init = yes }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_plc_ran_m } remove_global_variable = oe_plc_ran_m }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_plc_ev_m } remove_global_variable = oe_plc_ev_m }
    oe_plc_monthly = yes
}
